job_reqs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
job_reqs.jd_text: Looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with 5+ years building distributed systems in Python or Go. Must have production experience with PostgreSQL, message queues (Celery/RabbitMQ/Kafka), and REST API design. Experience with async programming and containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes) required. Bonus: exposure to ML/NLP pipelines.

job_reqs.title: Data Scientist, NLP
job_reqs.jd_text: Seeking a Data Scientist focused on NLP to build text classification and semantic matching models. Requires strong Python, experience with spaCy/HuggingFace transformers, and a track record shipping models to production. Familiarity with embeddings, fairness evaluation, and explainability techniques is a strong plus.

job_reqs.title: Frontend Engineer, Internal Tools
job_reqs.jd_text: Frontend Engineer to build internal admin tools. React or server-rendered templating experience, comfort working directly with backend teams on API contracts, and an eye for clean, fast internal UI over flashy design.

candidates.resume_snippet: 6 years building backend services in Python/Django and FastAPI. Led migration of batch pipeline from cron to Celery+Redis, cut latency 40%.

Senior Software Engineer, 6 years experience.
